Finding: Legacy cloud snapshot endpoints are not authenticated
Impact: Anyone who knows/obtains a user UUID or name can use legacy load/save flows; PIN sessions are not attached to snapshot requests.
Smallest safe repair: Disable cloud controls and legacy name login in public builds until every data endpoint requires a verified session and ownership check.

Finding: Identity-specific public resource links are compiled into seed/product code
Impact: Shared Drive/Notion/Mega URLs and personal labels become visible to every deployed user and repository reader.
Smallest safe repair: Move personal defaults to private local fixtures; ship only reviewed public resources.

Finding: web/package.json is not standalone despite web README/workflows implying web-local install
Impact: A clean web-only npm ci cannot resolve node:crypto/node:fs types; typecheck/build exit 1.
Smallest safe repair: Add @types/node to web devDependencies or exclude tests from production build via separate tsconfigs; document root npm ci as authoritative.

Finding: CSV/JSON explicit-letter-with-drift policy contradicts pasted-text Q1 policy
Impact: Structured import drops an explicit valid letter when trailing text drifts, while paste keeps candidate + review; users get inconsistent repair behavior.
Smallest safe repair: Return a resolution result with candidate/evidence/status; preserve valid explicit letter as candidate with needsReview unless exact conflicting option text proves contradiction.

Finding: Most product routes are eagerly imported into the app shell
Impact: 819,498-byte app JS (234,486 gzip) includes nearly every route; slower first load and broad regression coupling.
Smallest safe repair: Lazy-load genuinely heavy route families (Question Bank, Course Tracker, Anki, boards) at stable boundaries; keep shared shell eager.

Finding: Core modules have mixed responsibilities and exceptional size
Impact: Changes have wide blast radius and make targeted ownership/testing harder.
Smallest safe repair: Extract domain slices/adapters without schema rewrites; preserve action contracts.

Finding: Service worker caches every same-origin GET without response validation or bounding
Impact: Dynamic/API GETs can be cached indefinitely under one release cache and storage pressure is unbounded.
Smallest safe repair: Cache only static hashed assets/core, require response.ok/basic, cap runtime entries, never cache /api.

Finding: Public URLs and repository identity remain Noctyrium
Evidence: origin remote; web/src/lib/brand.ts:19; DashboardPage.tsx:60; root package metadata
Impact: User-visible hosted links and repository instructions can point at stale legacy identity.
Smallest safe repair: Decide repository rename/redirect and replace hosted URL from one reviewed source of truth.

Impact: A missed bump can leave stale cache/update messages.
Smallest safe repair: Generate all release metadata from one build-time source and add a verification gate.

Finding: Automated route tests do not include an axe/WCAG ruleset
Impact: Semantic/focus tests are good, but contrast/name/state regressions lack systematic scan coverage.
Smallest safe repair: Add axe-core as a dev dependency and scan representative populated states in both themes.

Finding: Legacy Swift/native assets, scripts, RTF, and three blueprint PDFs remain tracked
Evidence: Package.swift; Sources/Noctyrium; Resources; scripts/legacy; Quote Librabry v1.txt.rtf; blue-prints
Impact: Harmless to runtime but obscures product boundary; MCAT PDF alone is ~8.3 MB.
Smallest safe repair: Jafar decision: archive/tag or retain only source assets with license/provenance.

Finding: Doctordle, leaderboards, and application checker are routable but incomplete
Smallest safe repair: Keep badges and exclude from Alpha capability claims; optionally hide from default navigation.

Finding: IndexedDB fallback can duplicate a full workspace into two localStorage keys
Impact: When IndexedDB is unavailable, quota pressure is doubled and large workspaces may fail writes.
Smallest safe repair: Write one canonical fallback key, surface quota failures, test large payload behavior.

Finding: Node 26 emits localStorage experimental warnings during tests
Impact: No product regression; obscures signal in CI.
Smallest safe repair: Use supported Node LTS and explicit jsdom/fakes; pin CI runtime.

Smallest safe repair: Obtain/archive source spec or formally waive Step 0 and record provenance gap.
